_guide: // learning-journey.json - one card per learning activity in the Learning Journey section.
// schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// section: heading text plus on/off switches for search, filters, sorting and detail views.
// REQUIRED per activity: id, title. Everything else is optional and hidden when empty.
// id: unique and stable, prefix journey- (journey-001). Career Timeline references it.
// title: what you studied, e.g. 'Modern JavaScript patterns'.
// categoryId: must match an id in categories[] below.
// description: one or two sentences on what and why.
// source: { name, url } where you studied; url must be a full https link.
// status: 'in-progress' or 'completed'; completed renders a green chip.
// progress: { enabled, value 0-100, unit, description }. enabled false = no bar.
// goals: what you set out to learn. keyLearnings: what you actually took away.
// relatedSkillIds: ids from skills.json, used by search.
// featured: true highlights the card. order: manual position.
// isSample: true marks example content; the section then shows a notice.

section.title: Learning journey
section.subtitle: What I am studying, and what I finished. Every record is an example that shows the progress bar, goals and source link.
